title: Orbs rise out of the sea for Danny Jones at Indian Rocks Beach
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Orbs rise out of the sea for Danny Jones at Indian Rocks Beach, about 2025 at Indian Rocks Beach, Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: When I asked it, just like out of the sky, it comes up out of the sea. And suddenly, here it came. Two of them. Wow. and he filmed it.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says glowing balls of light called orbs appear when he asks, says that in 2025 at Indian Rocks Beach in Florida he asked for one to show up for a man named Danny Jones. He says two orbs rose up out of the sea and Jones filmed them, which he offers as proof that the orbs respond to him.
